zh2en:递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement，: Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) means an AI system continuously interacts with tasks, environments, or other agents and turns experience and feedback into persistent changes to itself. These changes can be to model parameters, the surrounding agent framework, or even the improvement strategy itself. The key is that they can also affect the mechanisms that later “generate, evaluate, select, and consolidate” improvements
zh2en:通俗地说,图 7 讲的是同一个教训的三种落地方式:做成工具、改进框架: Put simply, Figure 7 shows three ways the same lesson can be put into practice: turned into a tool, used to improve the framework, or formally adopted only after a controlled experiment.
zh2en:通俗地说:B0 像一个每次考试都从零开始、做完就忘的学生;L1 像一: Put simply: B0 is like a student who starts from scratch on every exam and forgets everything afterward; L1 is like a student who keeps an "error notebook" using the method the teacher gave and consults it on the next exam. But how the notebook is organized is still dictated by the teacher.
zh2en:通俗地说:B0 就像一个学生在同一张考卷上反复涂改答案,交卷后什么也: Put simply: B0 is like a student who keeps erasing and rewriting answers on the same exam paper, learns nothing after handing it in, and starts from scratch on the next exam.
zh2en:通俗地说:HCI 衡量的是「从基准刚出现时的最好水平到满分之间,这段: Put simply: HCI measures "what percentage of the remaining gap between the best score when the benchmark first appeared and a perfect score has been closed." This puts benchmarks of different difficulty on the same scale.
zh2en:通俗地说:L1 像是按菜谱炒菜的厨师,L2 像是尝了味道后自己决定「: Put simply: L1 is like a chef who cooks by following a recipe; L2 is like a chef who tastes the dish and decides for themselves "whether the next batch needs more salt or less oil." The recipe's goal (making a tasty dish) and the judging criteria (who tastes it and how it's scored) are still set by someone else.
zh2en:通俗地说:L1 的 AI 是一个非常能干、不知疲倦的\"按 SOP: Put simply: an L1 AI is a highly capable, tireless "executor that follows the SOP." Its contributions accumulate, but it can't decide how the SOP is written, nor can it autonomously choose which improvement to try next. The latter is exactly what the next level, L2 (autonomy over improvement strategy), addresses.
zh2en:通俗地说:L4 是\"学到了新本事\",L5 是\"改进了自己学本事: Put simply: L4 is "learning a new skill"; L5 is "improving its own method for learning skills, and actually using it the next time."
zh2en:通俗地说:不只是\"模型做题、做错了再训练\",而是把\"出题的环境: In plain terms: it's not just "the model solves problems, gets them wrong, and gets retrained"; the "environment that sets the problems" gets improved too. The better the environment, the more it exposes what the model truly can't do; the stronger the model, the more it can help build harder environments and problems.
zh2en:通俗地说:不只是修 bug,而是修\"修 bug 的人\"。: In plain terms: it's not just fixing bugs, but fixing "the one who fixes the bugs".
zh2en:通俗地说:不同版本、不同跑法的分数不能硬比,宁可少画,也不把口径不一: In plain terms: scores from different versions or different run setups can't be forced into a comparison. Better to plot fewer points than connect points measured in inconsistent ways into one line.
zh2en:通俗地说:不奖励\"碰运气提高一点分\",而奖励\"做完这个实验后我: In plain terms: don't reward "getting lucky and nudging the score up"; reward "after this experiment, we understand the problem better".
zh2en:通俗地说:不是\"这一代变强了\"就够了,而是要证明\"这一代让下一: In plain terms: "this generation got stronger" isn't enough. You have to show that "this generation makes the next generation better at getting stronger".
zh2en:通俗地说:不要\"头痛医头\",要先做对照实验,确认病根到底在哪个环: In plain terms: don't just treat the symptoms. Run controlled experiments first to confirm which step the root cause is actually in.
zh2en:通俗地说:与其给用户写一段笼统的\"人设描述\",不如分成三个格子分: In plain terms: instead of writing a vague "persona description" for a user, record it in three separate slots. Whichever slot is wrong, fix only that slot.
zh2en:通俗地说:人和知识库先把房子的框架定死,AI 在框架里面随便折腾装修: In plain terms: people and the knowledge base lock in the house's frame first, and the AI is free to experiment with the interior within that frame, with the parts that turn out well getting fixed in place. This is fast and doesn't mess up the overall structure.
zh2en:通俗地说:传统论文像一份\"成品菜谱\",ARA 像\"厨房全程录像: In plain terms: a traditional paper is like a "finished recipe", while ARA is like "full kitchen video footage plus an ingredient list plus a record of failures", so the next cook can pick up right where things left off.
zh2en:通俗地说:像一个研究组共享一本带完整代码和日志的实验记录本。每个人每: In plain terms: it's like a research group sharing a lab notebook with complete code and logs. Before anyone starts work, the group lead picks a few pages of different experiences from the notebook for them to consult. Every new experiment, whether it succeeds or fails, also gets recorded back in the notebook.
zh2en:通俗地说:内环是\"改作业\",外环是\"改批改作业的方法\"。: In plain terms: the inner loop is "grading the homework", and the outer loop is "improving how the homework is graded".
zh2en:通俗地说:分数涨了,要先问\"功劳是 AI 自己的,还是那套写死的搜: In plain terms: when the score goes up, first ask "does the credit go to the AI itself, or to the hard-coded search framework?"
zh2en:通俗地说:前者是员工变熟练,后者是\"带新人的方法论\"越来越好。: In plain terms: the former is an employee getting more skilled; the latter is the "methodology for training new hires" keeping getting better.
zh2en:通俗地说:同样是\"改提示词\",一个系统是人定方向、AI 动手,另: In plain terms: both are "editing prompts", but in one system humans set the direction and the AI does the work, while in the other the AI decides for itself whether and how to make changes. In the RSI sense, these are not the same thing.
zh2en:通俗地说:在真实用户使用中自动发现问题、自动修,修完再上线,形成持续: In plain terms: problems are found and fixed automatically during real user usage, and the fixes are shipped, forming a continuous loop.
zh2en:通俗地说:如果\"考生\"和\"出题阅卷人\"一起进化,就必须留一把: In plain terms: if the "test-taker" and the "examiner and grader" evolve together, you must keep an external ruler that doesn't change along with them.
zh2en:通俗地说:如果发现考题出得有漏洞,智能体可以用「抄近道」拿高分,那就: In plain terms: if the test turns out to have loopholes that let the agent score high by "taking shortcuts", fix the test first, then continue testing.
zh2en:通俗地说:底层是「把这次的答案改好」,中间是「让系统越用越好」,顶层: In plain terms: the bottom level is "improve this answer", the middle is "make the system get better with use", and the top is "make the way the system improves itself keep getting better too".
zh2en:通俗地说:技能库就像公司知识库,存得越多不等于越好用,还得有人定期整: In plain terms: a skill library is like a company knowledge base. Storing more doesn't make it more useful; someone has to regularly organize, verify, and retire entries.
zh2en:通俗地说:改进器提方案,验证器把关,通过的写进系统状态,带着新状态的: In plain terms: the improver proposes changes, the verifier gatekeeps, and approved changes are written into the system state; the system carrying the new state is the successor. If what gets changed is the means of improvement itself, such as a "strategy", the loop starts to become recursive.
zh2en:通俗地说:普通的\"自我改进\"只是这次做得比上次好;RSI 还要求: In plain terms: ordinary "self-improvement" just means doing better this time than last time; RSI also requires the AI to get better and better at improving itself, so that the ability to improve compounds too. That is exactly what "recursive" means.
zh2en:通俗地说:每条结论都要\"拿日志对账\"或\"拿证明器过一遍\",没: In plain terms: every conclusion must be "reconciled against the logs" or "run through a prover", and anything that doesn't check out isn't allowed into the store, so errors don't snowball down the line.
zh2en:通俗地说:比赛中途换裁判可以,但必须拿一套公认的标准答案先考新裁判;: In plain terms: you can change referees mid-game, but the new referee must first be tested against an agreed-upon answer key; once the referee is changed, all scores given by the old referee are voided and re-scored.
zh2en:通俗地说:省下的是\"每次算多少\",省不掉的是\"整个系统怎么搭\: In plain terms: what you save is "how much is computed each time"; what you can't save is the complexity of "how the whole system is put together".
zh2en:通俗地说:看一个系统属于哪一级,要问的是“这一轮的改进由谁拍板、结果: In plain terms: to tell which level a system belongs to, ask "who signs off on this round's improvement, whether the result can persist, and who decides what counts as passing", not what technology it uses.
zh2en:通俗地说:研究问题「好不好」很难判定,工程问题「过没过、快了多少」一: In plain terms: whether a research problem is "good" is hard to judge, but whether an engineering problem "passed, and how much faster it got" is clear as soon as you test it. That's why engineering is better suited to letting AI iterate in a closed loop on its own.
zh2en:通俗地说:第一步是\"及格线\",先把不合格的挡掉;第二步是\"新旧: In plain terms: step one is the "passing bar", filtering out anything that doesn't qualify; step two is the "old vs. new comparison", where a new version must beat the old one to replace it.
zh2en:通俗地说:系统每推荐一次,就\"押了一个注\",看用户的反应是否验证: In plain terms: each recommendation the system makes is "placing a bet". It watches whether the user's reaction confirms that judgment, then revises its understanding of that person accordingly.
zh2en:通俗地说:级别越高,人从\"手把手教\"一步步退到\"只划红线\"。: In plain terms: the higher the level, the more humans step back, from "hands-on teaching" to "only drawing red lines".
zh2en:通俗地说:老工程师把排障经验写成\"故障排查手册\",AI 照着手册: In plain terms: veteran engineers write their troubleshooting experience into a "troubleshooting manual", and the AI follows the manual step by step.
zh2en:通俗地说:这一层的 AI 不是在\"决定怎么训练\",而是在按人写好: In plain terms: at this layer, the AI isn't "deciding how to train"; it's grading homework according to procedures written by humans and producing reward and penalty signals.

The comparison estimate is 3 to 5 engineers working for 6 to 12 months. Model FLOPs utilization (MFU, actual compute as a share of the hardware's theoretical peak) rose from 40.1% to 44.1% on MiniCPM4-0.5B and from 47.0% to 50.9% on an 8B model. ForgeStencil applies the method to scientific computing kernels, reporting speedups of 1.15x to 1.9x over the best public implementations, with a median end-to-end speedup of 1.41x.

On Discovery Feed, score_mean@16 went from 2.211 to 2.366 (+7.0%) and score_median@16 from 1.587 to 1.663 (+4.8%). On the in-video Feed, score_mean@16 went from 1.537 to 1.739 (about +13.1%), but this was a small offline evaluation with 470 items for the baseline and 447 for the new model.
zh2en:（公司自报）：两个月内发起 216 个改进任务，涉及 117 个专家: (company-reported): Over two months, 216 improvement tasks were launched involving 117 expert agents, and the paper says “63 of them” completed at least one full evolution cycle (it doesn't make clear whether the 63 refers to tasks or agents; if tasks, the 76 tasks used for comparison below exceed the number completed, so the figures don't add up). On 76 tasks compared with the same evaluator, the average score rose from 5.25 to 5.87, with a median machine processing time of 27.8 minutes per completed cycle. But the HCI section, which is used to argue “where RSI should be applied,” should be taken with a grain of salt:
- The endpoint of the “RSI-boosted” bar on the right is set directly by Equation 4 to fill 78% of the remaining gap. So “the bigger the gap, the bigger the RSI gain” is an assumption plugged in, not something derived from data, and the value 0.22 has no stated justification.
- The down-weighting of self-reported results (×0.75) only applies when the same result has multiple sources. The paper calls it a “sensitivity adjustment” but includes no sensitivity analysis.
- In the latest-model audit, the 16 results left out of the curves due to protocol mismatches all come from interactive benchmarks such as Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE, CyberGym, ExploitBench, AutomationBench, and BrowseComp, which is exactly where the paper says “the gap is largest.” The set of benchmarks aggregated each year may also change. Tool agents jumped from 8.2 to 39.9 in one year, and the paper doesn't break down how much of that comes from benchmarks being added or dropped.
- Figure 3 labels capability domains “L1–L2” and “L3–L4,” which effectively maps benchmark scores to autonomy levels. This sits awkwardly with the statement in §1.7 that levels are “not assigned by model capability.”

- Prompt search: GEPA (Dropbox used it to rewrite the prompt that judges search result relevance), Promptbreeder, MPO, C-Evolve.
- Agent and harness search (the harness is the prompts, tool calls, and execution logic wrapped around the model): Microsoft Foundry's Agent Optimizer rewrites a hosted agent's system instructions, skills, and tool descriptions based on evaluation failures. Others include ADAS, AFlow (which uses Monte Carlo tree search to modify workflow graphs), and AgentSquare.
- Model and training search: NVIDIA's 2026 TAO workflow has a coding agent call LLM-guided AutoML under a fixed validation target to post-train Cosmos 3. AgentNAS uses an LLM to generate seed architectures and build the search space. OpenAI's NanoGPT evaluation of GPT-6 Astra provides one GPU and a fixed target, and lets the agent diagnose training bottlenecks and modify the training code on its own. Karpathy's autoresearch fixes the data, the evaluation function, and the compute per experiment. The agent repeatedly modifies the training program, and changes are kept only if the protected validation metric improves.
- System implementation search: AutoKernel starts from performance profiling, and candidate Triton/CUDA implementations are accepted only if they pass correctness checks and show a measured speedup.

zh2en:：Hyra（Hunyuan Research Agent）故意走轻量: : Hyra (Hunyuan Research Agent) deliberately takes a lightweight approach. Instead of writing ever more complex hand-crafted workflows, it gives the agent a wide solution space and uses experimental evidence to guide further search until the agent decides to stop or the budget runs out. At its core is the Experience Bank, which stores not just text memories but also previous solution code, artifacts, execution logs, scores, and evaluation feedback. A Context Agent reorganizes this evidence into diverse “inspiration contexts.” Multiple Proposal Agents read them asynchronously, generate new solutions, and run them in fresh isolated sandboxes, and the results are written back to the Experience Bank. For open-ended tasks where the initial evaluator is incomplete or can be gamed, Hyra uses accumulated experience to revise the evaluation mechanism before continuing the search. For example, it may increase granularity, strengthen comparison baselines, or close reward-hacking loopholes. The paper says this is “especially relevant to RSI,” because what gets persistently updated is no longer just better solutions but also the mechanism for “judging what counts as an improvement.”

It proposes Forge Engineering: given a target model, hardware platform and parallelism requirements, AI starts from an empty codebase and builds, tests and optimizes a working implementation.
- Inner loop (single scenario): humans and AI jointly maintain a knowledge base (specs, evaluation criteria, engineering experience). The agent first uses it to set the high-level architecture and narrow the search space, then an AutoResearch loop repeatedly generates implementations, tests correctness and performance, and diagnoses and fixes bottlenecks. Successful optimizations (such as GEMM and FlashAttention kernels) are gradually merged into the main path.
- Outer loop (cross-scenario): lessons from successes and failures are written back to the knowledge base and become the starting point for the next project. The company reports applying this to pretraining frameworks, operator libraries, reinforcement learning infrastructure, inference engines, fine-tuning, compression, quantization and on-device deployment.
